Maho Hiyajo (Steins;Gate 0) replaces Maru 
this is a follow up [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2214]for a previous mod we made of Makise Kurisu [/url]﻿

[How to Install]
> Download and extract file
> Copy the .xnb Files to Folder \Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits (rar is organized by folders so make sure to follow the "guide")

You SHOULD ALWAYS backup original portrait files before installing the mod
